decisions.reason: As a fashion-sensitive decorative line with several variants, its market signal should be clear by 2022 and the assortment and inventory costs of keeping it open are no longer justified if it has not proven itself strongly.

This transparent burnout decorative line is close to the core business but style-driven, so after three seasons management would likely close the option and free warehouse and sampling capacity for stronger ranges.
A single burnout decorative fabric is easier to discontinue once demand information has emerged, and by 2022 the firm would likely abandon it unless it had become a reliable reorder item.
A velour-like upholstery fabric fits the established upholstery offer and can generate repeat business, so the firm has reason to keep the option open unless sales clearly disappoint.
The flame-retardant plain inbetween fabric is a functional extension of the core range with relatively predictable customer use, making it inexpensive and strategically sensible to retain.

A polyester lining fabric with satin sheen is a practical adjacent product that supports the firm's service-oriented textile offer, so management would likely keep it unless turnover proved persistently weak.
